name: Thane Borrik Anvilheart
role: Thane of the Anvilhall: keeps the greatest of the dwarven forges and sells Gearsflat its steel at a price he sets once a decade
appearance: Broad as a door, beard braided with iron rings, forge-scars to the elbow, and an apron he wears to council because he came straight from the anvil.
voiceHints: Says what a thing weighs before he says what it is. Laughs from the belly, rarely, and means it.
wants: To have the Anvilhall's steel in every good blade at the Crossing, and his name on none of them.
fears: A forge going cold in his lifetime.
knowledge: Which Gearsflat workshop is buying more steel than it can use
What the deep heat under the mountain is doing, and that it is changing

reactsToReputation.honest: names you a fair price and keeps it for life
reactsToReputation.reliable: lets you past the market hall, which almost nobody gets
reactsToReputation.greedy: doubles the price and tells you why
reactsToReputation.any: weighs you before he greets you

questSeeds: The mountain's heat is rising and Borrik does not know why
A Gearlands engineer wants into the deep forges and will pay anything
gear: a forge-hammer he made at sixteen
a ring of the Anvilhall's keys
title: Thane of the Anvilhall
_sng670: Pass 2: the leader of the pocket's ruling power.
physicality: ADULT. Broad as a door, short and immensely heavy. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: forge-scars to the elbow, and an apron worn to council.

abilities.why: enginewright primary: the forges are machines, and he knows every one
a hold built to take a blow
a smith knows where steel fails, and so where a man does
mason secondary: knows a thing's true weight by touch
sets the price of steel once a decade, and it holds
finds the one stone a thing rests on

intimacyNotes: NOT AVAILABLE: he has been married to the Anvilhall's forges for sixty years and says so without irony.
